dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Court of Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Grosley
dialogues.text: You may ride the lift at the side to the Court, and there you shall see the Palais Mermonia, the beating heart of Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Grosley
dialogues.text: If you've ridden one of our aquabuses, I'm sure you've heard a Melusine tour guide introduce Fontaine, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Grosley
dialogues.text: Well, now you'll get to experience it for yourself.
